summaries.en: US President Donald Trump publicly urged South Korea to join the US military's 'Project Freedom' operation in the Strait of Hormuz, citing an alleged Iranian attack on a South Korean cargo ship.
summaries.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普公开敦促韩国参与美国在霍尔木兹海峡的“自由项目”军事行动，理由是伊朗涉嫌袭击了一艘韩国货船。
